reviews.text: Best Vets I’ve ever been to. The staff are wonderful and incredibly loving towards the animals. Great environment and very calm for pets. Took my cat for a de matting today and the staff were extremely accommodating when I was nervous about using sedation. Can’t recommend them enough:)

Just had our first visit to Purple vets me and my British bulldog Bronson and what an amazing vets, so impressed and we can’t wait for next weeks follow up appointment!! Best vets in Rothwell that’s for sure !!

We have been using purple vets for a few years now and are incredibly happy with their service. Our chihuahua has had to have a few more procedures this year and the team there have been great. They are friendly, kind and genuinely interested in his health. They are great at fitting us in last minute when we have a concern and are very reasonably priced.
Great vets. All staff are so friendly and genuinely care. Wouldn't take my 2 dogs anywhere else.
Small but cozy welcome environment. Amazing staff, very kind with my pet. Thanks to the locum doctor who looked after my pet

We used Purple Vets for the first time yesterday for our little guinea pig.
They were so helpful, kind and got us in to see a vet very quickly.
They definitely aren't in it for the money like a lot of Vets nowadays and they're genuinely concerned about your pet.
At one very well known vet practice I was quoted £90 consultation fee that's before medication.
Purple Vets were so reasonable in comparison I was incredibly impressed....I would DEFINITELY RECOMMEND them if you want a kind, caring and reasonably priced veterinary surgery.
Thank-you Purple Vet's.

Fantastic vets. Caring and compassionate staff. We’ve been using Purple Vet for just over a year. Our cat had to have an unexpected surgery for a broken jaw. The staff were excellent in explaining the procedure and the follow up treatment.

I have taken my pets to this vets for several years. Sadly I’m now going to go elsewhere. The vet who used to be there has partly retired I believe and when I last went I had a different vet. This chap was bordering on passive aggressive. I was making small talk about the vet changing and he became some what confrontational asking if there was a problem and if I wanted to continue. It wasn’t just what he said but the way that he said it. As I say he was unpleasant and I didn’t nt plan to return.
The team and the vet were absolutely lovely. They answered all my questions and were very reassuring.
Great independent vets with friendly and helpful staff.

Lovely small vets, so your pet isn't mixing with lots of other animals. Which is great if you have a nervous pet. The staff are amazing, you can tell they love animals. They are knowledgeable  and always happy to give advice. You feel your pet comes first, not money like some vets.
Very polite and friendly staff. Availability seems to be good with no issues.

I have been with Purple vets for around 5 or 6 years now with my 2 cats. The staff and vets have always had my best interests. The nurses there have always been so friendly and when I’ve called for advice they’ve been able to give a helping hand. One of my cats was recently diagnosed with cancer and as pain relief and steroids weren’t helping the size of the mass I asked for advice on other options. They referred me to paragon. It may have not been the positive result I hoped for but they still went above and beyond to make sure I got the answers I needed. When my cat had to be PTS they were there and there was no rush, I was able to say my last goodbyes to my dear old friend before she went over the rainbow bridge. They were very empathetic and supportive throughout the process. I always gave them a call if I needed advice. Consultations are free and everyone is very friendly. I would definitely recommend using Purple vets to others. Thank you for helping me through a very difficult time.

Shopped around for a local vet to have my dog neutered. I was recommended to try Purple Vets who I decided to contact. From beginning to end the staff were really friendly and made me feel at ease. They answered all my questions and nothing was too much trouble. They were very thorough when advising me on after care. I can highly recommend them.
Excellent vet very nice staff very helpful Very polite recommend 100%
